patterns_detail: On-FPGA BIST drives the sha256 memory-mapped register interface through one complete NIST FIPS-180-4 KAT ('abc' SHA-256) = 101 register-interface bus transactions (17 writes: 16 BLOCK0..15 + 1 CTRL MODE|INIT; 84 reads: STATUS polls through the ~66-cycle compute + 8 DIGEST0..7 reads), then compares the 256-bit digest bit-exact against the golden ba7816bf...f20015ad.
method: Real Quartus Prime 23.1std full compilation (Analysis&Synthesis -> Fit place&route -> Assembler -> TimeQuest STA) of a self-checking BIST harness (sha256_bist_top.v) wrapping the real sha256 DUT, targeting DE10-Lite MAX10 (10M50DAF484C7G). A 3.2MB .sof bitstream was produced. No physical DE10-Lite/USB-Blaster board was connected (device_fpga_de10lite_detect -> cables:[]), so on-board JTAG programming was not run; instead the exact BIST harness was verified by RTL simulation (iverilog), which asserts LEDR[0]=PASS (digest==golden) and LEDR[1]=DONE. This is the BFM/pre-silicon-equivalent path the benchmark-verify skill permits when no board pin contract / physical board is available, stated honestly.

sta_multicorner.note: Setup + hold >= 0 at every analyzed corner (Slow 1200mV 85C, Slow 1200mV 0C, Fast 1200mV 0C); Fmax comfortably above the 50 MHz board clock.
